confirmation_split.purpose: frozen candidate vs baseline robustness; not untouched external test

selection: validation supported improvement only; no leaderboard tuning

targeted_followups.reason: Raw LightGBM models train in <30 sec. Test nonmonotonic ratings as categories and small label-free summaries; no public score observed for new models. Also compare intermediate CatBoost depth7 at lower learning rate, because depth8 gains are small and depth6 baseline hit its round cap.

category_followup.reason: Targeted categorical rating copies improved LGB63 primary AUC from .9577875 to .9578926 in 24sec. Test all rating copies with same hyperparameters once before freezing candidates.
